synopsis: Chapter 3 and the glossary identify ISO/IEC TS 22440 Parts 1–3 as committee drafts in 2026, rather than published specifications [f2101, f15300, f2384]. The series covers AI functional safety, with Part 1 addressing requirements, Part 2 guidance, and Part 3 examples of application [f2728, f2384]. The committee drafts were registered on 9 February 2026, and their comment period closed on 11 April 2026 [f2385]. Both locations judge publication much before 2027 or 2028 unlikely because the documents remain committee drafts; this is an uncertain forecast, not a confirmed publication schedule [f2386, f15300]. For validation planning, the corpus specifically identifies the series’ testing provisions as still draft provisions [f2729].
